answer: By binding each identity to a bonded stake whose weight decays per epoch as willow bending under load, the protocol makes cheap pseudonyms unprofitable because fresh keys must reacquire costly collateral. A randomized beacon elects a rotating lantern committee that cross-attests stake provenance, so colluding agents cannot quietly recycle identities without their correlated. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
